name: Facets View Mode Processor
description: Provides a facets processor to render items as view modes.
project_description:
This module extends the facets module and provides a processor to render facet entity reference items as view modes

 Installation 
 See the README.md file for detailed installation instructions.

 Usage 
 
 Create a facet based upon an entity reference field (for example Taxonomy term) 
 Navigate to the processors of the facet and check "Transform entity ID to view mode" 
 Choose the view mode to render the items in 
 
 Important : Make sure the HTML rendered in the view mode is valid HTML to be used with a checkbox element. Not all HTML is allowed. I suggest you override the template of your chosen view mode to take full control on how each facet item is rendered.
